title: AgentPeerBinding
description: Declares that a libp2p peer identity (PeerId) is operated by a specific Holochain agent (AgentCid). Source of truth: DHT (Notarized, Category A — imagodei integrity zome). The ActionHash of the DHT entry is the canonical identifier; the SQLite projection in peer_identity_bindings carries dht_anchor_hash to link back. The 'signature' field is the agent's Ed25519 signature over the canonical binding body — all fields except 'signature' and 'supersededBy', deterministically serialized — so that libp2p peers can verify bindings received via handshake or gossip without fetching the DHT entry. 'supersededBy' is absent at creation and set only when this binding is superseded.

peerId.description: libp2p PeerId, multibase-encoded (base58btc multihash of the peer's public key). Stable identity of the network-layer peer.

agentCid.description: CIDv1 (dag-cbor sha256) of the Agent EPR in imagodei — the content-addressed identifier of the Holochain agent that operates this peer. Binds the network identity to the protocol identity.

validFrom.description: UTC timestamp (RFC3339, Z suffix) from which this binding is valid. Included in canonical signing bytes.

validUntil.description: UTC timestamp (RFC3339, Z suffix) at which this binding expires, or null if the binding has no declared expiry. Included in canonical signing bytes when present.

deviceArchetype.description: Hardware/deployment archetype of this peer. Affects replication weight, availability expectations, and collective resource allocation.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical binding body. Canonical body is the deterministic serialization of all fields except 'signature' and 'supersededBy' (supersededBy is set post-creation when superseded; it must not be included so signatures remain stable across the binding's lifetime). Enables libp2p peers to verify bindings received via handshake or gossip (elohim/identity/binding topic) without a DHT round-trip.

supersededBy.description: ActionHash (base64url-encoded Holochain ActionHash) of the AgentPeerBinding DHT entry that replaces this one, or null if this binding is current. NOT included in canonical signing bytes — it is set externally when a superseding binding is notarized, so its absence at creation is required for signature stability. Propagated by the reconciliation controller (Principle P1) when a newer binding is observed.
